name: Ken Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2000 in Shanghai, China, Ken Holding Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of professional-grade power tools. Formerly known as Shanghai KEN Tools Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in July 2015, the company offers an extensive product catalog designed for diverse industrial applications. This includes a wide array of drilling solutions such as cordless, impact, diamond, and magnetic core drills, alongside standard drilling machines. Additionally, their offerings encompass grinding and polishing equipment, precision cutting tools like cut-off machines, miter saws, and marble cutters. The product line further extends to powerful rotary, heavy rotary, and demolition hammers; versatile jig and circular saws; and a range of shaping and finishing instruments including sanders, trimmers, routers, belt sanders, and planers. For accurate measurements, Ken Holding provides leveling lasers and laser rangefinders, along with miscellaneous utility items like blowers, heat guns, electric scissors, wrenches, and specialized car service tools. These high-performance tools are indispensable across critical sectors such as aerospace, maritime, automotive, petrochemical, machinery, and construction.
